context.name: piano.practice_context
context.coordinate_frame: MuJoCo world; key-relative targets require explicit conversion
context.embodiment: ShadowHand pair + native passive RoboPianist piano
context.state_semantics: full integration state and MIDI latch/history; never reset at composition boundaries

operation.note: Design contracts only. Existing Python controllers require explicit adapters; declaring a contract does not implement one.

promotion_requirements: freeze score, initial state, evaluator and full dependency revisions
compare incumbent and candidate from identical source state
check repair window, recovery window and continuous full song
preserve previously correct note identities; do not trade omissions for fewer wrong pitches
qualify transfer separately on held-out pieces and tempi
evaluation.enforcement: Specified requirements, not a newly installed runtime gate.
